cases.description: Missing critical GPU specifications in RTX 5090 product comparison
cases.topic: NVIDIA RTX 5090 vs AMD RX 8900 XT specs verification
cases.detail: Detected missing VRAM bandwidth (GB/s) and TDP (watts) specifications across 3 comparison sites. NVIDIA's official spec sheet lists 1024 GB/s and 450W TDP, but TechRadar, Tom's Hardware comparison tables omit these crucial metrics.

cases.description: Drug trial results missing adverse event data
cases.topic: Ozempic clinical trial Phase III results
cases.detail: FDA-approved label includes detailed adverse events (nausea 20%, vomiting 9%), but popular health news articles from WebMD and Healthline discussing efficacy completely omit safety data. Critical gap for informed patient decisions.

cases.description: Credit card terms missing foreign transaction fee disclosure
cases.detail: Marketing page emphasizes travel benefits but omits 3% foreign transaction fee mentioned in terms PDF (page 47). Comparison with Capital One Venture X (0% fee) reveals competitive disadvantage being concealed.

cases.description: Tesla Model Y recall information 8 months outdated on manufacturer site
cases.topic: 2024 Tesla Model Y safety recalls verification
cases.detail: Tesla's recall page last updated March 2024, shows only 2 recalls. NHTSA database reveals 5 additional recalls issued between April-October 2024 affecting 180k+ vehicles (seatbelt issues, brake software). Owners relying on Tesla site miss critical safety updates.

cases.description: Amazon return policy outdated after September 2024 changes
cases.topic: Amazon Prime return window policy changes
cases.detail: Help center article dated February 2024 states 30-day return window. Policy changed September 15, 2024 to 90 days for Prime members. Detected across 12 help articles still showing old 30-day policy, potentially causing customers to miss return windows.

cases.description: CDC COVID booster recommendations not updated for 2024-2025 formula
cases.topic: COVID-19 booster eligibility and timing guidelines
cases.detail: State health department site references June 2023 CDC guidance for bivalent boosters. CDC updated recommendations September 2024 for new monovalent formula with different dosing intervals (4 months vs previous 6 months). Stale guidance affects 2.3M state residents.

cases.description: Meta Q3 2024 revenue: CEO interview vs official 10-Q filing mismatch
cases.detail: Mark Zuckerberg in Bloomberg interview (Oct 28) stated Q3 revenue of '$40.6 billion, up 19% year-over-year.' Official 10-Q SEC filing (Oct 25) reports $40.59B, up 23% YoY. $10M discrepancy minor but 19% vs 23% growth rate materially different for investor decisions.

cases.description: Microsoft 365 Business license seat count differs across sales channels
cases.topic: Microsoft 365 Business Premium concurrent user limits
cases.detail: Microsoft's official licensing page: 'Up to 300 seats per organization.' Reseller CDW's product page: '5-300 users.' Azure Marketplace listing: 'Minimum 10 licenses required.' Conflicting information creates confusion about small business eligibility (<5 employees).

cases.description: Climate study findings misrepresented in news coverage
cases.topic: Nature Climate Change: Global warming acceleration study Nov 2024
cases.detail: Reuters headline: 'Scientists warn warming accelerating 50% faster than predicted.' Original Nature study abstract states: 'Observed warming 15-22% above mid-range model projections for 2020-2024 period.' 50% claim appears nowhere in paper. Detected across 8 news outlets amplifying incorrect figure.

cases.description: WhatsApp privacy policy contradictions between regions
cases.topic: WhatsApp data sharing with Meta — US vs EU policies
cases.detail: US privacy policy (updated Aug 2024): 'We share user data with Meta companies for ads, product improvement.' EU privacy policy (GDPR version): 'WhatsApp does not share user data with Meta for advertising.' Same app, contradictory policies create confusion for international users.

cases.description: iPhone 15 Pro Max specifications consistent across all verified sources
cases.topic: iPhone 15 Pro Max technical specifications verification
cases.detail: Verified Apple.com, GSMArena, Qualcomm, TSMC sources. All report: A17 Pro chip (3nm), 8GB RAM, 6.7" OLED (2796×1290), 48MP main camera, USB-C 3.0, 4422mAh battery. Zero discrepancies across 15 reviewed sources including retail partners and tech reviewers.

cases.description: Apple Q4 FY2024 earnings aligned across all reporting channels
cases.topic: Apple Inc Q4 FY2024 financial results verification
cases.detail: Cross-verified SEC 10-K filing, Apple investor relations press release, earnings call transcript, and analyst reports. All sources consistently report: Revenue $94.93B (up 6% YoY), EPS $1.64, Services $24.97B, iPhone revenue $46.22B. No conflicts detected.

cases.description: Pfizer Paxlovid dosing guidelines consistent across medical sources
cases.detail: FDA label, CDC guidelines, WHO treatment guidelines, and clinical pharmacology databases all consistently specify: 300mg nirmatrelvir + 100mg ritonavir twice daily for 5 days. Renal dosing adjustments identical across sources. Perfect alignment for patient safety.

cases.description: COVID-19 vaccination dashboard: stale data and missing methodology
cases.topic: Johns Hopkins COVID-19 vaccination tracker reliability
cases.detail: Dashboard shows 'Last updated: May 2024' (6 months stale). Additionally, no methodology documentation for how 'fully vaccinated' is calculated (2 doses vs 3 doses inconsistency). Missing links to CDC WONDER database as data source. Detected both staleness and critical gaps.

cases.description: Health insurance marketplace: outdated premiums and missing subsidy calculator
cases.detail: State exchange shows 2023 premium rates (stale by 12 months). Missing: subsidy eligibility calculator and out-of-pocket maximum disclosures required by ACA. Federal Healthcare.gov updated October 2024 with 2025 rates and tools. State site lagging creates misinformation.
